fixed_bugs.fix_applied: Changed parameter annotations from Optional[str] = None to Optional[str] = Form(None)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Feed feature is fully functional. Caption/location bug was fixed by adding Form() annotations to the POST /api/posts endpoint parameters. All CRUD operations for posts, likes, and comments are working. Sonner toast notifications are working correctly after the next-themes import fix.

rca_of_the_issue.bug: Caption and location not saved during post creation
rca_of_the_issue.root_cause: FastAPI requires explicit Form() annotation for form data parameters when used with File uploads. The original code had 'caption: Optional[str] = None' which doesn't work with multipart/form-data requests.
reproduction_steps: 7. Observe that caption and location are null in the created post
rca_of_the_issue.fix_applied: Changed 'caption: Optional[str] = None' to 'caption: Optional[str] = Form(None)' and same for location parameter. Also added Form import from fastapi.
rca_of_the_issue.verification: Tested via curl and Playwright - caption and location now correctly saved
